title: The Long Road Home
story: The King Says, “You May Go Home!”
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In Babylon so far away,
God's people longed each day.
Then King Cyrus stood up and said,
"Go home! God made a way!"

[Chorus]
The Lord keeps every promise made,
He keeps His word to you.
So trust Him with your little heart,
For all He says is true.

[Verse 2]
The king gave back the temple bowls
Of silver and of gold.
The people packed their bags with smiles,
Just as the Lord foretold.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
God's promise holds you tight.
He kept His word so long ago,
He'll keep it through the night.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music. A steady, easy walking pulse moves under the voice, like families setting off down the long road home with bags on their backs. The lift in the chorus feels like a promise being kept, warm and sure. By the last verse the steps slow to a stroll, the pulse softens, and everything settles low and quiet as the journey ends at bedtime.
